svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The LocalGrid network
svg.desc: LocalGrid's network. Circles are access points and small rectangles are handhelds. Eight access points pass messages to each other in hops, every one within three hops of the rest, with three handhelds on each. Some handhelds do push-to-talk; the rest send text and listen. There is no Internet. Above, GPS satellites give the main access point its time and location, and some handhelds have their own GPS; both optional. A laptop beside the grid watches it over Bluetooth without joining. Three of the access points carry a LoRa module and link to each other directly over it, drawn as the heavy arcs running beneath the mesh, their APs ringed: a longer-range second path used when the Wi-Fi link between two of them cannot reach. Two handhelds carry a LoRa module and a GPS as well, shown faded above their GPS markers, because their LoRa firmware has not been written yet.
svg.text: The LoRa backbone: the three ringed APs link to each other directly
